title: Join Analytics
content: Premium servers can now access powerful Join Analytics & Member History tools to better understand their community growth.
• Server Growth Overview — Track joins, leaves, and overall member growth.
• Member History — View detailed join history, account age, roles, and time spent in your server.
• Analytics Export — Export member data as a CSV file for advanced tracking.
• Growth Graphs — Visualise your server's growth trends over the last 30 days.
⚠️ Analytics tracking begins after this update is installed. Previous member activity cannot be recovered. Graphs require at least 3 days of collected data before they become available.
Want to unlock Analytics and other premium features? Get Joinly Premium here!

title: Website Upgrade
content: Our legal documents are now available from a dedicated Legal page, making it easier to find both our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.
We've also moved the Status History page under the Status section, giving it a cleaner and more intuitive URL structure: /status/history!
